svg.title: Two springs
svg.desc: Two masses on springs of the same stiffness, pulled down together and let go. The one on the left is critically damped, as every glide on the FM-1's screen is: it slides to its target and never crosses it. The one on the right is under-damped, like the plucked lines beside a knob: it overshoots and rings. A trace beside each spring draws its height against time.
